name: FrenchModelVariant458_HandleRequest
evidence: matching french_model_variant/variant458_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4; for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, uploads the texture images and sets up the sheets, strands and streamers, otherwise it runs one frame (strands and streamers from the config's draw start, sheets after its sheet start, ambient and fade) and returns 4 while phases 3-6 run, then 1 once and 2; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md); config/sles_03948/overlays/README.md
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image. French header numbering (North American header 441). HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
